questions.question: What object did God have Jeremiah break in chapter 19, in the Valley of Hinnom?
options: A long scroll all covered over with writing
A linen belt taken from off his own waist
A heavy wooden yoke made for the neck

questions.question: What did breaking the flask symbolize?
options: That the holy temple would at last be rebuilt after the exile ended
That God would break this people and this city beyond mending
That the people would be reshaped by him into something wholly new
That the great army of the enemy would soon be shattered to pieces
questions.answer: That God would break this people and this city beyond mending

questions.question: Jeremiah condemned the people for burning their children as offerings at Topheth.
I will shatter this people and this city, like a potter's jar that can never again be _____.
Jeremiah broke the flask in the Valley of the Son of _____ (Topheth).
